subject: Isolate the primary foreground subject and render the background with a strong shallow depth-of-field bokeh blur, using the foreground subject as the in-focus plane. Simulate approximately f/1.4 lens blur — smooth, circular, pleasant bokeh in the out-of-focus background. Preserve all foreground subject detail, color fidelity, and edge sharpness exactly. The background should become a creamy, separated bokeh layer behind the crisp subject.
